04 — OUR STORY

ISLAMIA COLLEGE UNIVERSITY PESHAWAR

Started at Islamia College University Peshawar.

DECEMBER 2025 PESHAWAR, PAKISTAN

Sociapi began at Islamia College University Peshawar in December 2025. Students now take part through workshops, events, projects, volunteering, and campus chapters.
